rows.label: tlk70000161_01_msg0001
rows.name:
I'm a nameless Nopon traveling across
Alst, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000161_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I've been traveling alone, so talking
to people is a relief, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000161_01_msg0004
rows.name:
As thanks for that relief, I'll give
you a special Assist Core I picked up
by that pond, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000161_01_msg0005
rows.name:
It won't be any use to me, so don't
hold back, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000161_01_msg0006
rows.name:
I'm sure it'll be perfect for a Blade
who's really into brawling, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000161_01_msg0007
rows.name:
How was the Assist Core I gave you,
mo?

rows.label: tlk70000161_01_msg0008
rows.name:
No... Asking what you thought would be
tactless, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000161_01_msg0009
rows.name:
I just think it's something special,
so please take good care of it, mo.
